entities.summary: Genoese, a notable figure in the history of Cyprus, associated with Lusignan Crusader Kingdom of Cyprus (1291–1374). Preceded by Famagusta's Golden Age and Guy de Lusignan establishes the Lusignan dynasty on Cyprus. Their legacy influenced Venetian Takeover and Caterina Cornaro.
